newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian interbank rates in broader range.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian interbank rates in broader range.

text.p: Interbank rates on the Egyptian pound were steady in the private sector on Monday but the range was broader, bankers said.
They quoted overnight rates at between 10 and 10-1/4 percent, from between 10-1/8 and 10-3/16 percent on Sunday.
One-week rates range from 10 to 10-7/16 percent, against between 10-1/4 and 10-5/16 percent on Sunday.
Public-sector banks continue to ask for a minimum of 10-1/2 percent for short-term lending.
